$comment: Per-section policy, enforced from the repo root by .claude/hooks/section-dispatch.sh. This is how you scope enforcement to a directory WITHOUT requiring a session started in that directory: one hook, registered once, that dispatches on the edited file's path. Per-package .claude/settings.json hooks only fire when Claude is started in that package; this fires everywhere.
$howto: match = substring of the repo-relative path. forbid[].pattern = extended regex tested against the new file content. First matching section wins.

forbid.message: Route handlers must not import the data layer. Call a service in src/services/ — a handler that queries the database cannot be tested without HTTP and leaks the data model into transport.
Raw SQL in a route handler. Queries belong in src/db/, called through a service. See apps/api/src/routes/.claude/skills/route-handlers/SKILL.md.
Route handlers must not read process.env. Configuration is validated once at boot in src/core/config.ts and injected — see src/core/.claude/skills/core-boundaries/SKILL.md.
A service must not know about HTTP. Throw a domain error; the transport layer in src/routes/ maps it to a status code.
Web framework import in the service layer. Services take domain inputs and return domain outputs — that is what makes them testable without a server.
core must not import the domain — everything imports core, so this creates a cycle. Invert the dependency: define the interface in core, implement it in the domain.
Utils must be pure and deterministic — no I/O, no env, no clock, no randomness. Pass the value in as an argument so the function stays testable.
Components must not fetch. Data access lives in apps/web/src/api/ and is passed down as props — see apps/web/src/api/.claude/skills/data-layer/SKILL.md.
Stores are synchronous client state; fetching belongs in src/api/. Server data cached in a store gains a second owner and starts disagreeing with the server.
packages/shared must stay pure and importable from anywhere — scripts, tests, both apps. No I/O and no environment reads at this level.

Destructive DDL in a migration. Use expand → migrate → contract across separate deploys: add the new shape, backfill and dual-write, and only drop once nothing reads the old one. See .claude/rules/migrations.md.
